reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/decode.rs owns tablelist nodes, selectively owned command/variable bytes and an environment-cache chain of copied names/values. add_cmd_table consumes an owned buffer even for empty input or failed node allocation.
owner_creation.invariant: Each node must retain whether its buffer is owned or borrowed.
limitations: Static default command tables are not heap buffers to release.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/decode.rs lgetenv returns raw pointers from variable tables, cached copies or libc environment storage. lgetenv_ext lends caller env_buf through a temporary non-owning node that is removed before return.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A returned value must outlive removal of its temporary descriptor.
limitations: Removing a borrowed node does not free the caller env_buf backing bytes.

callback_targets.analysis: src/decode.rs is reached by sigusr lgetenv lookup, which can call addenv_cache and allocate copied strings before returning to the handler queue producer.
callback_targets.invariant: Configuration lookup allocation must remain outside asynchronous handlers.
limitations: M0-SIG-002 remains open for this concrete caller route.

invalidation.analysis: src/decode.rs retain_cmd_table saves successors before freeing discarded nodes, nulls the retained tail and republishes the selected root. Its stated initialization-only scope must precede any table-byte borrower.
invalidation.invariant: Published table aliases cannot survive table-list pruning.
limitations: Current owns_buffer release code does not close historical M0-LEAK-004.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/decode.rs lesskey_text uses a fresh parser descriptor, publishes command/edit buffers and releases copied variable input afterward. The repaired transfer avoids resetting a descriptor still owning published bytes (M0-LEAK-003).
mutation_commit.invariant: Staging descriptors must never remain allocation owners after transfer.
limitations: Whole configuration precedence and concurrent lookup are separate obligations.

release_pair.analysis: src/decode.rs release_cmd_table frees t_start only when owns_buffer, then frees the node; pop detaches the selected tail before invoking that release. Borrowed default and temporary bytes survive node destruction.
release_pair.invariant: Descriptor lifetime must not be confused with borrowed byte lifetime.
limitations: Cached environment allocations have their own persistent lifetime beyond table pop.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/decode.rs now skips pop when no temporary node was added, preserving persistent tables on empty input or allocation failure (M0-MEM-002). Failed parsing deinitializes all staged table buffers before return.
error_cleanup.invariant: Rollback must remove only a node that this operation actually inserted.
limitations: The maintained repaired findings remain open pending independent disposition.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/decode.rs table/cache roots are mutable raw globals; sigusr invokes lookup while ordinary code can borrow them. Ownership flags fix local frees but provide no asynchronous configuration handoff.
signals_handoff.invariant: Lookup and table retirement must obey one serialized owner protocol.
limitations: No new table-race runtime result is claimed from raw structure alone.

src/signal.rs.relationship: sigusr at src/signal.rs:86-100 invokes lgetenv before queue creation; decode.rs can traverse raw table roots or allocate environment-cache records during that asynchronous lookup.
